data.narrative:
Bohr Systems is a pre-seed stage defense and security company founded by Rohil Gharat (former Antler, Founders Inc., Cisco) and Samarth Kumbla (Columbia CS '27). The valuation analysis draws from a broader Defense & Security sector universe comprising 2 public comps (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private peers, including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, Saronic, and Quantum-Systems.

The peer-median approach is not applicable here. While 21 same-sector peers exist in Defense & Security, the combination of pre-seed stage, company size, and valuation tier constraints yields fewer than three comparable datapoints needed for statistical reliability. Specifically, the search identified 0 same-stage peers, 1 adjacent-stage peer, and 0 similar-tier peers—below the minimum threshold. A cross-sector median would introduce material bias and is therefore not pursued.

Without sufficient narrow-stage comparables and absent founder-disclosed metrics (prior funding, current valuation, revenue, or margin data), quantitative triangulation cannot be completed to a defensible range. Valuation at this stage would require either (1) additional pre-seed or seed-stage Defense & Security transactions to establish peer density, or (2) disclosure of Bohr's own traction metrics and capital needs. The analysis supports deferring point or range estimates pending data sufficiency.
